threat_event: Ransomware enters through the acquired firm's VPN with stolen passwords and SMS codes, then crosses the directory trust
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: VPN accepts SMS codes; directory trust live; no group EDR or SIEM on the acquired estate
affected_asset_or_process: Acquired firm VPN, identity provider, endpoints, file shares
existing_controls: Legacy antivirus; firewall rules on the trust
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA on the VPN by 2026-10-31; group EDR on all acquired endpoints by 2026-12-31; retire the trust at migration (POAM-018)
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: DoD CUI held on the acquired firm's file shares outside the enclave is compromised, triggering DFARS reporting and a CMMC failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 340 acquired consultants on DoD work use acquired laptops and shares
affected_asset_or_process: Acquired firm file shares; DoD programs
treatment_plan: Inventory and move CUI into the enclave; block CUI on acquired shares (POAM-020)

threat_event: Malware on acquired firm endpoints goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy antivirus; not in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Group EDR on all acquired endpoints (POAM-018)
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: No CMMC Level 2 status when DoD solicitations require it (Phase 2 is suspended; Level 2 (Self) may still be required)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assessment not scheduled; inheritance undocumented; enclave gaps
treatment_plan: Schedule a C3PAO (voluntary while Phase 2 is suspended); inheritance matrix; close gaps (POAM-019, POAM-024)

threat_event: A DoD cyber incident is not reported within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only 2 staff hold DoD-approved medium assurance certificates, both in one office
treatment_plan: Certificates for 4 more staff in two locations; add DoD reports to the group matrix
owner: IT Consulting federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: Federal contract information is mishandled on federal civilian engagements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group controls cover the 15 FAR requirements; acquired staff not yet trained
treatment_plan: Train acquired staff on federal work
owner: IT Consulting federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: Consultants paste client or agency data into public AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Approved enterprise assistant available; acquired staff not blocked from public tools
regulatory_driver: POL-05; N54-R05 (DFARS 252.204-7012(a) definition of compromise) for CUI
treatment_plan: Block public AI tools on acquired endpoints; training
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Subcontractors on DoD work lack the DFARS 252.204-7012 flowdown or a current assessment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 96 DoD subcontracts not checked since the acquisition
treatment_plan: Review the 14 subcontracts; verify SPRS and CMMC status before award
owner: IT Consulting federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: PHI from public hospital engagements is kept on consultant laptops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 19 business associate engagements; data handling varies
treatment_plan: PHI only in client systems or the delivery workspace
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Consultants keep access to agency systems after rolling off
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agencies own the accounts; roll-off notices are manual

threat_event: Phishing of a consultant leads to compromise of an agency network
existing_controls: Group training; MFA on group accounts
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for staff with agency privileged access
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: The CMMC affirmation or SPRS score is inaccurate, creating False Claims Act exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SPRS score from 2025-06 does not reflect the acquired estate
treatment_plan: Re-score after the CUI inventory; counsel sign-off before each affirmation (POAM-024)
owner: IT Consulting federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: Staff follow the acquired firm's older policies instead of group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IT Consulting supplement predates the acquisition
treatment_plan: Re-issue the supplement covering the acquired staff (POAM-025)
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: A laptop with client data is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption on group laptops; acquired laptops encrypted with legacy tool
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Client deliverables and data are kept after engagements end
Proposal and pricing data is stolen by an insider leaving for a competitor
Workspaces are shared externally by mistake
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: External sharing allowed by default in acquired workspaces
treatment_plan: Apply group sharing defaults to acquired workspaces at migration
owner: IT Consulting security and compliance lead
